thumbnail_brief: One heavy, scarred bull walrus (no smile, big tusks and whiskers so it never reads as a seal) rising out of dark water with its tusks hooked over a tipping dinghy, tiny red-capped Doug inside holding an oar, so the image shows the method (climbing and tipping, no bite) while the title promises 'without a single bite'; text 'WRONG BOAT' or 'IT'S CLIMBING IN', never WALRUS, BITE or KILLS, and any count shown is 35,000.
description:
Walruses mostly eat clams, yet a walrus sank a Russian Navy boat in 2019, and some bulls hunt seals. In this walrus facts deep dive Doug meets one walrus, then two, then hundreds, then the roughly 35,000 that hauled out near Point Lay, Alaska, and dies to tusks, weight and a stampede, never to a bite.

Where should we send Doug next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad decision.
